```artifact
Feature: Lab In-charge and Patient functionalities

  Scenario: Lab In-charge can view open lab-requests and update status
    Given the lab in-charge is logged in
    And there are open lab-requests
    When the lab in-charge views the lab-requests
    Then the lab in-charge can update the status of the lab-requests
    And the status is updated successfully

  Scenario: Patient can view prescription and print invoice
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient has a prescription
    When the patient views the prescription
    Then the patient can print the invoice
    And the invoice is printed successfully

  Scenario: Admin can print and email prescription and invoice
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the patient has a prescription
    When the admin prints and emails the prescription and invoice
    Then the prescription and invoice are printed and emailed successfully

  Scenario: Patient profiles are archived after 3 years of inactivity
    Given it has been 3 years since the patient last raised a consultation request
    When the system checks for inactive patient profiles
    Then the patient profiles are archived

  Scenario: Consultation requests are archived after 3 years
    Given it has been 3 years since the consultation request was raised
    When the system checks for old consultation requests
    Then the consultation requests are archived

  Scenario Outline: Lab In-charge can view open lab-requests and update status with different status values
    Given the lab in-charge is logged in
    And there are open lab-requests
    When the lab in-charge views the lab-requests
    Then the lab in-charge can update the status of the lab-requests
    And the status is updated successfully
    Examples:
      | status |
      | Actual Sample Collection |
      | Lab tests offline |

  Scenario Outline: Patient can view prescription and print invoice with different prescription values
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient has a prescription
    When the patient views the prescription
    Then the patient can print the invoice
    And the invoice is printed successfully
    Examples:
      | prescription |
      | Prescription 1 |
      | Prescription 2 |

  Scenario Outline: Admin can print and email prescription and invoice with different prescription values
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the patient has a prescription
    When the admin prints and emails the prescription and invoice
    Then the prescription and invoice are printed and emailed successfully
    Examples:
      | prescription |
      | Prescription 1 |
      | Prescription 2 |

  Scenario Outline: Patient profiles are archived after 3 years of inactivity with different patient profile values
    Given it has been 3 years since the patient last raised a consultation request
    When the system checks for inactive patient profiles
    Then the patient profiles are archived
    Examples:
      | patient_profile |
      | Patient Profile 1 |
      | Patient Profile 2 |

  Scenario Outline: Consultation requests are archived after 3 years with different consultation request values
    Given it has been 3 years since the consultation request was raised
    When the system checks for old consultation requests
    Then the consultation requests are archived
    Examples:
      | consultation_request |
      | Consultation Request 1 |
      | Consultation Request 2 |
```
